summary: Hasura generates instant GraphQL APIs directly from existing PostgreSQL databases. It includes fine-grained access control policies and supports triggering webhooks on database events.
goodFor: Developers who need a rapid GraphQL interface over a PostgreSQL schema without writing boilerplate API routing code.
watchOut: Adopting this tooling ties your API layer tightly to its specific execution model and schema introspection patterns, which can complicate future migrations away from it.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via containers on Kubernetes or Docker, requiring persistent storage for configuration and a reliable connection to your PostgreSQL instance behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.
